title: The Hidden Treasure and the Pearl
reflectionText: Two comparisons, two discoveries: treasure hidden in a field and one pearl of great value. In each, the finder sells all he has to obtain what he has found, and the man who found the treasure acts in joy. Jesus pictures the kingdom as worth more than everything else a person holds. What would you gladly let go of for something of greater worth?
